description: Physics-lumped shunt capacitor bank PFC. Steady-state reactive compensation Qc = P*(tan(phi1)-tan(phi2)) with achieved PF, released capacity and voltage rise; detuned-reactor resonance/series-resonant frequency; lumped RLC energization-transient ODE (inrush) via scipy.solve_ivp.

unit.name: Generic 11 kV Shunt Capacitor Bank, 1 MVAR (optionally detuned)
unit.source: IEEE Std 1036-2010 (Guide for Application of Shunt Power Capacitors); Grainger & Stevenson (1994) Power System Analysis, McGraw-Hill; IEC 60871-1.

Q_rated_kVAR.note: Total capacitor bank reactive rating at rated voltage

C_uF.note: Per-phase delta bank capacitance: C = Q/(2*pi*f*V_LL^2) = 1e6/(2*pi*50*11000^2) per phase grouping; documented value is the lumped single-phase-equivalent used in the energization ODE.

n_stages.note: Number of switched/automatic capacitor stages (250 kVAR each)

detuning_pct.note: Detuned-reactor tuning p (e.g. p=7% => series resonance at 1/sqrt(p)=3.78x fundamental, below 5th harmonic)

loss_factor.note: Bank dielectric+switching losses as fraction of Qc (0.3%)

esr_ohm.note: Lumped equivalent series resistance of bank+reactor loop, damps energization transient (IEEE 1036 inrush)

Lsys_mH.note: System (source) inductance seen at the bank, per-phase equivalent; X = 2*pi*f*L = 3.0 Ohm => SCC ~ 40 MVA at 11 kV
